definitions.explanation: The short growth of beard on a man who has not shaved for a day or more, from laziness or busyness. Unlike a beard grown on purpose, it suggests neglect, though it can be a deliberate rugged look.

examples.japanese: {無精|ぶしょう}ひげ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びている→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
⟦{徹夜|てつや}{明|あ}け→徹夜明け：14910_tetsuyaake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{無精|ぶしょう}ひげ⟦だらけ→〜だらけ：18372_darake⟧だ。
examples.english: After an all-nighter he's covered in stubble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦{剃|そ}ら→剃る：00384_soru⟧ずにいたら、{無精|ぶしょう}ひげ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{生|は}えそろってしまった。
examples.english: I didn't shave during the holiday, and a full growth of stubble came in.

notes:
{無精|ぶしょう} (also written ⟦{不精|ぶしょう}→不精：28186_bushou⟧) means lazy, not bothering; so the word is "lazy beard".

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無精|ぶしょう}ひげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|は}やす→生やす：02399_hayasu⟧: to have (let grow) stubble
- {無精|ぶしょう}ひげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剃|そ}る→剃る：00384_soru⟧: to shave off stubble
- {無精|ぶしょう}ひげ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧: stubble grows

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ひげ→ひげ：01332_hige⟧: beard, mustache — the general word
- ⟦あごひげ→あごひげ：20973_agohige⟧ / ⟦{口|くち}ひげ→口ひげ：33046_kuchihige⟧: chin beard / mustache
